story_zh: 小明想买几件衣服。他问店员：“这件衣服多少钱？”店员说：“一百块，很便宜。”小明觉得贵，问：“有没有便宜一点的衣服？”店员说：“有，那件五十块。”小明买了两件衣服，很高兴。
story_pinyin: Xiǎomíng xiǎng mǎi jǐ jiàn yīfu. Tā wèn diànyuán: “Zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián?” Diànyuán shuō: “Yībǎi kuài, hěn piányi.” Xiǎomíng juéde guì, wèn: “Yǒu méiyǒu piányi yīdiǎn de yīfu?” Diànyuán shuō: “Yǒu, nà jiàn wǔshí kuài.” Xiǎomíng mǎi le liǎng jiàn yīfu, hěn gāoxìng.
story_en: Xiaoming wants to buy a few pieces of clothing. He asks the clerk: “How much is this piece of clothing?” The clerk says: “One hundred yuan, very cheap.” Xiaoming thinks it’s expensive and asks: “Do you have cheaper clothes?” The clerk says: “Yes, that piece is fifty yuan.” Xiaoming buys two pieces of clothing and is very happy.
